title: CMake: Fix which dissectors are ASN.1 dissectors
description:
Some ASN.1 dissectors are not in the ASN1_DISSECTOR_SRC list variable,
and some non-ASN.1 dissectors are in that list.

Having an accurate list makes it easier to ignore certain warnings
only for the ASN.1 dissectors (if fixes require changing asn2wrs.py)

notes.body: enabled automatic add to merge train when checks pass
